name: mirage
text: Nothing in the code checks your Kalshi cash itself: the 'not enough money' text only appears when Kalshi's own answer says so. The engine reads your Kalshi cash as $6.29, so a $0.49 bet should fit. I need Kalshi's exact words, which the app currently hides. I'm making the card show them verbatim (code and detail) and will ship that so we can see the real reason.
